verdict.rationale: ClickUp's docs explicitly describe an Automations feature, event-triggered workflows, and autonomous 'Agents' (Super Agent, Codegen Agent, Triage Agent) that 'Work 24/7' with 'Infinite memory,' directly matching background autonomous automation for AI-native users. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these agents reliably run unattended in production, and more detail on configuring/monitoring long-running automations beyond marketing copy.
